criteria: Rheumatoid arthritis (adult; rheumatologist): moderate-to-severe RA, positive RF/anti-CCP (or tested for RF, anti-CCP and CRP/ESR), and 3-month methotrexate 15+ mg/wk without low disease activity or MTX intolerance/contraindication plus csDMARD criteria; or biologic/targeted synthetic within past 120 days. Also: unable to take a preferred adalimumab (non-preferred product); negative TB test within 12 months if biologic-naive; no concurrent biologic/targeted synthetic for the same indication.

Articular JIA (age 2+; rheumatologist): moderate-to-severe; inadequate response to methotrexate/csDMARD, OR to NSAIDs/intra-articular steroids plus a risk factor, OR high-risk joints/activity; or prior biologic. Also: unable to take a preferred adalimumab (non-preferred product); negative TB test within 12 months if biologic-naive; no concurrent biologic/targeted synthetic for the same indication.

Psoriatic arthritis (adult; rheumatologist or dermatologist): active PsA; severe, OR mild-moderate with csDMARD failure/intolerance/contraindication or enthesitis/axial disease; or prior biologic. Also: unable to take a preferred adalimumab (non-preferred product); negative TB test within 12 months if biologic-naive; no concurrent biologic/targeted synthetic for the same indication.

AS or nr-axSpA (adult; rheumatologist): active disease; inadequate response, intolerance or contraindication to 2+ NSAIDs; or prior biologic/targeted synthetic. Also: unable to take a preferred adalimumab (non-preferred product); negative TB test within 12 months if biologic-naive; no concurrent biologic/targeted synthetic for the same indication.

Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis (gastroenterologist): moderately to severely active disease; no other criteria listed. Also: unable to take a preferred adalimumab (non-preferred product); negative TB test within 12 months if biologic-naive; no concurrent biologic/targeted synthetic for the same indication.

Plaque psoriasis (adult; dermatologist): moderate-to-severe; crucial body area, OR 10%+ BSA, OR 3%+ BSA with failed phototherapy/MTX/cyclosporine/acitretin or reason to avoid them; or prior biologic/targeted synthetic. Also: unable to take a preferred adalimumab (non-preferred product); negative TB test within 12 months if biologic-naive; no concurrent biologic/targeted synthetic for the same indication.

Hidradenitis suppurativa (age 12+; rheumatologist or dermatologist): moderate-to-severe; 8+ weeks oral antibiotic failed, or intolerance/contraindication; or prior biologic. Also: unable to take a preferred adalimumab (non-preferred product); negative TB test within 12 months if biologic-naive; no concurrent biologic/targeted synthetic for the same indication.

Non-infectious uveitis (age 2+; ophthalmologist or rheumatologist): intermediate/posterior/panuveitis; inadequate response, intolerance or contraindication to corticosteroids or immunosuppressants; or prior biologic. Also: unable to take a preferred adalimumab (non-preferred product); negative TB test within 12 months if biologic-naive; no concurrent biologic/targeted synthetic for the same indication.

Behcet's disease (rheumatologist): inadequate response to 1+ nonbiologic drug (e.g., colchicine, steroids, azathioprine); or prior Otezla/biologic. Also: unable to take a preferred adalimumab (non-preferred product); negative TB test within 12 months if biologic-naive; no concurrent biologic/targeted synthetic for the same indication.

Pyoderma gangrenosum (dermatologist): inadequate response, intolerance or contraindication to corticosteroids and immunosuppressants; or prior biologic. Also: unable to take a preferred adalimumab (non-preferred product); negative TB test within 12 months if biologic-naive; no concurrent biologic/targeted synthetic for the same indication.

Immune checkpoint inhibitor-related inflammatory arthritis (oncologist, hematologist or rheumatologist): moderate-severe; inadequate response, intolerance or contraindication to corticosteroids/csDMARD. Also: unable to take a preferred adalimumab (non-preferred product); negative TB test within 12 months if biologic-naive; no concurrent biologic/targeted synthetic for the same indication.

criteria: Rheumatoid arthritis (18+; rheumatologist): moderate-to-severe RA; baseline disease activity and treatment goals documented; not at goal on maximally tolerated methotrexate, OR methotrexate contraindication/serious side effects plus a 3-month trial of one other DMARD. Also: attested no active/latent untreated infection; no concurrent TNF/biologic/JAK/PDE4; non-preferred reference product needs failed preferred biosimilar.

Juvenile idiopathic arthritis (2+; rheumatologist): SJIA or non-systemic JIA with onset before 16; baseline disease activity and treatment goals documented; non-systemic JIA also needs failure/contraindication of ~12+ weeks of methotrexate, hydroxychloroquine, sulfasalazine or leflunomide. Also: attested no active/latent untreated infection; no concurrent TNF/biologic/JAK/PDE4; non-preferred reference product needs failed preferred biosimilar.

Psoriatic arthritis (18+; rheumatologist or dermatologist): active PsA; baseline disease activity and treatment goals documented; 3-month failure/contraindication of leflunomide, methotrexate, sulfasalazine or cyclosporine, OR severe PsA, OR severe psoriasis. Also: attested no active/latent untreated infection; no concurrent TNF/biologic/JAK/PDE4; non-preferred reference product needs failed preferred biosimilar.

Plaque psoriasis (4+; rheumatologist or dermatologist): moderate-to-severe (BSA 3%+, or sensitive areas); baseline disease activity and treatment goals documented; failure/contraindication of TWO systemic therapies (3+ months) or 3-month phototherapy, or both contraindicated. Also: attested no active/latent untreated infection; no concurrent TNF/biologic/JAK/PDE4; non-preferred reference product needs failed preferred biosimilar.

Crohn's disease (6+; gastroenterologist or colorectal surgeon): diagnosis plus 1+ high-risk feature; baseline disease activity and treatment goals documented; failure/contraindication of >3-month immunomodulator trial, or documented reason it cannot be used. Also: attested no active/latent untreated infection; no concurrent TNF/biologic/JAK/PDE4; non-preferred reference product needs failed preferred biosimilar.

Ulcerative colitis (5+; gastroenterologist or colorectal surgeon): moderate-to-severe UC; baseline disease activity and treatment goals documented; 2-month systemic agent failure/contraindication, OR severe disease, OR pouchitis with failed antibiotic/probiotic/enema. Also: attested no active/latent untreated infection; no concurrent TNF/biologic/JAK/PDE4; non-preferred reference product needs failed preferred biosimilar.

Ankylosing spondylitis (18+; rheumatologist): AS; baseline disease activity and treatment goals documented; failure/contraindication of TWO NSAIDs for 3+ months; if prominent peripheral arthritis, also methotrexate or sulfasalazine trial. Also: attested no active/latent untreated infection; no concurrent TNF/biologic/JAK/PDE4; non-preferred reference product needs failed preferred biosimilar.

Hidradenitis suppurativa (12+; dermatologist): Hurley II-III; baseline disease activity and treatment goals documented; counseled on supportive measures; 3-month oral antibiotic AND antiandrogen failure/contraindication, and intralesional steroid failure/contraindication. Non-infectious uveitis (2+; ophthalmologist): intermediate, posterior or pan-uveitis; baseline disease activity and treatment goals documented; failure/contraindication of an intravitreal or systemic steroid, antimetabolite or calcineurin inhibitor, OR severe Behcet's uveitis. Also: attested no active/latent untreated infection; no concurrent TNF/biologic/JAK/PDE4; non-preferred reference product needs failed preferred biosimilar.

Pyoderma gangrenosum (18+; rheumatologist or dermatologist): diagnosis documented; baseline disease activity and treatment goals documented; 6+ week trial and failure (or contraindication) of systemic glucocorticoids AND systemic cyclosporine.
